skill.name: chrome-extension-icons
skill.description: Generate Chrome extension icon assets by searching Iconify, converting SVG files to required PNG sizes, and updating manifest.json icon entries.
skill.summary: Create Chrome extension PNG icons and manifest entries from Iconify or local SVG files.
skill.author: Boulea7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings in SKILL.md and examples/usage.md are documentation-only false positives from command examples, URLs, and installed-skill paths. The executable script legitimately performs Iconify network requests and caller-controlled filesystem reads and writes, so those behaviors remain confirmed risks. The sudo dependency guidance is security-significant because it asks for privileged host changes.

remediation.issue: Caller-controlled input, output, manifest, and batch config paths can read or overwrite unexpected files.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize paths, reject traversal outside the project root, and require explicit confirmation before writing outside the current workspace.

remediation.issue: The skill includes sudo package installation guidance for dependency recovery.
remediation.suggestion: Move privileged installation steps to manual documentation and require clear user approval before any package manager command is run.

remediation.issue: Remote SVG content is downloaded from Iconify and processed locally.
remediation.suggestion: Keep requests limited to Iconify HTTPS endpoints and document that icon keywords and selected icon identifiers are sent externally.

remediation.issue: Existing icon files and manifest entries may be replaced.
remediation.suggestion: Create backups or show a diff before overwriting manifest.json and generated icon files.

content.value_statement: Chrome extension icons require several PNG sizes and manifest wiring. This skill searches Iconify, converts SVG assets, and updates extension icon settings.
actual_capabilities: Search Iconify for matching open-source icons by keyword.
Download selected SVG icons and convert them to Chrome extension PNG sizes.
Generate 16, 32, 48, and 128 pixel icon files with transparency.
Update manifest.json icons and action.default_icon entries when present.
Convert a local SVG logo into extension-ready PNG files.
Run batch icon generation from a project configuration file.
limitations: Requires Node.js and the Sharp image processing package.
Uses the Iconify API for search and remote icon downloads.
Can overwrite existing icon files and manifest icon entries.
Color replacement is simple and may not handle gradients or complex SVGs.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Extension Icon Set
use_cases.description: Generate required icon sizes and add the icon paths to a new Chrome extension manifest.

use_cases.title: Refresh Existing Extension Branding
use_cases.description: Search alternative icon styles and replace older icon files with a consistent new design.

use_cases.title: Convert a Company Logo
use_cases.description: Turn an existing SVG logo into PNG icon files that match Chrome extension requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Icons
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single extension icon.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate Chrome extension icons for my project using a calendar theme. Update the manifest if it exists.

prompt_templates.title: Use Brand Color
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate icons with a single brand color.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for a clean home icon and generate Chrome extension icons in #2563eb. Save them in the icons folder.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Local Logo
prompt_templates.scenario: Use an existing SVG asset instead of Iconify.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert my local logo.svg file into Chrome extension icon sizes and wire the paths into manifest.json.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Multiple Projects
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced batch generation for several extensions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create icons for three extension projects from a batch configuration. Verify each manifest and summarize successes and failures.

output_examples.input: Generate a bookmark icon for my Chrome extension.
output_examples.output: The skill finds a matching Iconify bookmark icon, creates four PNG files, and updates the manifest icon entries.
The skill reads the local SVG, exports the required PNG sizes, and reports the generated file names and sizes.

output_examples.input: Make icons for several related extensions.
output_examples.output: The skill processes each project, reports which projects succeeded, and identifies any project that needs manual correction.

best_practices: Preview the chosen icon before generating files for a production extension.
Back up existing icon files and manifest entries before replacing them.
Use simple single-color SVG icons when requesting custom color output.
anti_patterns: Do not run batch configurations from untrusted sources without reviewing file paths.
Do not overwrite production manifest files before checking the requested icon paths.
Do not expect complex multicolor SVGs to recolor cleanly with a single color value.

faq.question: What icon sizes does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates 16, 32, 48, and 128 pixel PNG files for Chrome extension manifests.

faq.question: Can it use my own SVG logo?
faq.answer: Yes. It can convert a local SVG file into the required PNG icon sizes.

faq.question: Does it update manifest.json automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create or update the icons field and action.default_icon when present.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Internet access is required for Iconify search and downloads. Local SVG conversion can work without Iconify.

faq.question: Can it generate icons for multiple projects?
faq.answer: Yes. Batch mode can process several projects from a configuration file.

faq.question: What should I review before using it?
faq.answer: Review output paths, manifest paths, and any dependency installation command before allowing changes.
